## Notes

Stability from blue (grounded) to red; falls with horizontal and vertical distance; a piece cannot exceed its support's stability; vertical limits 16 m for wood and stone, 24 m for core wood; uncovered wood decays to 50% durability; trees and boulders count as ground.
